source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949, p. 7 ("Nominations for county and rural councils: two contests in Antrim"); Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949, p. 5 ("County and rural council elections: polling took place yesterday")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'In County Antrim, where there are 23 electoral divisions, there will be two contests' (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949, p. 7); asterisks as printed mark retiring members.

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 17 May 1949, withdrawals to 18 May, and polling on Thursday 2 June 1949 ('POLLING took place yesterday', Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949, p. 5). Two divisions were contested, Portrush and Ballycastle; the other 21 members were returned unopposed. No party labels were printed. Returned unopposed.
